summary: Forward bootstrap-native-adoption from goal governance adopt (new-project 499)

delivery.outcome: goal governance adopt can perform the first adoption of a committed repository without governance so its first ticket can be allocated, and tells the operator when that route is needed.
nonGoals: No automatic bootstrap without the explicit flag
No change to the new-project generator or allocator
No writer, review or publication authority from the receipt

architecture.decision: Forward an explicit --bootstrap-native-adoption flag to the pinned create_adoption_lock.py, reject it with --pre-commit, and print a stderr note after a successful non-check adoption whose HEAD has no .governance/manifest.json.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the generator flag remains usable directly.
